A.description: two stop, one pass, pi in I0
A.endpoint_argument: kappa(pi)=0 for odd L (contradicts (C)); for even L, kappa(pi)=(-1)^(L/2)*cosh(A_-1)>0 -- so L even (d odd for odd n), sigma_2 (I0[1]) forced to (-1)^(L/2), sigma_1 (I0[0]) free

B.description: one stop, two pass, pi in I1
B.endpoint_argument: (E) at theta=pi: for even L, cosh(A_-1)<=1 => A_-1=0 exactly; for odd L, kappa(pi)=0, (E) automatic. Both parities admissible; sigma_1 (I0[0]) free.

grids.E_grid: concatenated I1 grid with theta=0 dropped (kappa(0)=1 identically)

constraints.A_and_D: automatic and exact for real matched alpha (not imposed)
constraints.B: delta >= max_{G1}(Q-1) over ALL I1 components, epigraph
constraints.C: sigma_i*kappa(theta) >= cosh(mu0) on each I0 component i, own sign sigma_i
constraints.E: |kappa(theta)| <= 1 on the E grid (all I1 components, theta=0 dropped)

starts.random_distribution: alpha_j ~ N(0,0.35^2) i.i.d., matched via alpha_n
starts.antisym_distribution: free half ~ N(0,0.35^2), filled via alpha_j=-alpha_{n-j}
starts.sym_distribution: free half ~ N(0,0.35^2), filled via alpha_j=alpha_{n-j} (raw start only -- NOT feasible/matched by construction; SLSQP does not require a feasible or symmetric start, per Sec 4 note)
continuation: best alpha_first at (n-2,d,sigma_free), embedded via a zero-contrast layer at each end

sigma_free note: for Geometry A, sigma_2 (the pi-containing component) is forced by parity and FLIPS sign between d and d-2 (since L/2's parity alternates every step of 2 in d) -- continuation is therefore keyed on sigma_1 alone (the genuinely free coordinate), letting sigma_2 re-derive itself at the target d. For Geometry B (single stop component) this is the identity.
starts.discard_rule: SLSQP res.success==False discarded; else fine-grid (16001-node) feasibility at tol 1e-9
starts.n_starts_total_per_case: 252 (A, with both continuation seeds available) or 250-252; 300-302 for B (adds the 50 symmetric starts)

rng.note: sweep_seed = 20260827+100, one np.random.default_rng stream consumed sequentially in geometry(A,B) x n(3,5) x d x sigma order -- reproducible only by replaying that exact case order.
